theme.en: AI Demand Pulls Packaging, Memory, and Policy Together
theme.zh: AI需求牵动封装、存储与政策

dek.en: AI infrastructure demand is pushing advanced packaging and server-memory roadmaps forward while governments fund domestic research and scrutinize supply choices. The next constraint is increasingly the system around the accelerator, not the accelerator alone.
dek.zh: AI基础设施需求正在推动先进封装和服务器存储路线图前移，同时各国加码本土研发投入并审视供应链选择。下一阶段的约束越来越来自加速器周边的系统能力，而非加速器本身。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD launches Ryzen Embedded AI X100 for physical-AI systems
title.zh: AMD推出面向物理AI系统的Ryzen Embedded AI X100

summary.en: AMD introduced the Ryzen Embedded AI X100 and outlined a physical-AI hardware stack spanning SoCs, modules, and developer kits. The move targets embedded and industrial deployments, where local perception and control workloads need a different product path from rack-scale GPU training.
summary.zh: AMD推出Ryzen Embedded AI X100，并展示了涵盖SoC、模块和开发套件的物理AI硬件栈。该产品面向嵌入式和工业部署；这些场景的本地感知与控制负载需要区别于机架级GPU训练的产品路径。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC reportedly develops an EMIB-like AI packaging approach
title.zh: 报道称台积电正开发类似EMIB的AI先进封装方案

summary.en: A report says TSMC is developing an AI-chip packaging technology analogous to Intel's EMIB approach. If commercialized, another bridge-based option could broaden how TSMC assembles large AI systems as interconnect density and package yield become central competitive variables.
summary.zh: 报道称，台积电正在开发一种类似Intel EMIB的AI芯片封装技术。若实现商业化，这一新增的桥接式选项可能扩展台积电组装大型AI系统的方式，因为互连密度和封装良率正成为关键竞争变量。

title.en: Samsung targets a second Taylor semiconductor plant by end-2026
title.zh: 三星计划在2026年底前启动泰勒第二座半导体工厂建设

summary.en: Samsung plans to begin construction on a second semiconductor plant in Taylor, Texas, by the end of 2026. The project would deepen the company's U.S. manufacturing footprint, though construction timing is only an early step before tool installation, process qualification, and volume output.
summary.zh: 三星计划在2026年底前启动美国得州泰勒第二座半导体工厂的建设。该项目将扩大其在美国的制造布局，但开工只是早期节点，后续仍需经历设备进厂、工艺认证和量产爬坡。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Renesas upgrades DDR5 MRDIMM chipset to 16,000 MT/s
title.zh: 瑞萨将DDR5 MRDIMM芯片组升级至16,000 MT/s

summary.en: Renesas launched its third-generation DDR5 MRDIMM chipset, including the RRG5013 MRCD and RRG5103 MDB, for server modules rated up to 16,000 MT/s. Faster multiplexed-rank memory is aimed at the bandwidth pressure of AI and cloud servers, where CPU and accelerator utilization increasingly depends on feeding data quickly enough.
summary.zh: 瑞萨推出第三代DDR5 MRDIMM芯片组，包括RRG5013 MRCD和RRG5103 MDB，支持最高16,000 MT/s的服务器模块。更快的多路复用Rank内存瞄准AI和云服务器的带宽压力，因为CPU和加速器的利用率越来越取决于数据供给速度。

title.en: DDR5 MRDIMM roadmap reaches 16,000 MT/s
title.zh: DDR5 MRDIMM路线图推进至16,000 MT/s

summary.en: Memory suppliers are preparing third-generation DDR5 MRDIMMs above 16,000 MT/s, with a stated eventual target of 17,600 MT/s; first-generation parts began above 8,000 MT/s. The roadmap underscores that server-memory bandwidth is being upgraded alongside AI processors, rather than treated as a secondary platform specification.
summary.zh: 存储厂商正准备速度超过16,000 MT/s的第三代DDR5 MRDIMM，并将最终目标定为17,600 MT/s；第一代产品起步速度已超过8,000 MT/s。该路线图表明，服务器内存带宽正在与AI处理器同步升级，而不再只是平台的次要规格。

title.en: Storage-inspired memory proposal targets multi-terabyte GPUs
title.zh: 受存储技术启发的新型内存瞄准多TB GPU容量

summary.en: A storage-inspired high-bandwidth flash concept is being positioned as a way to give GPUs capacities in the multi-terabyte range while seeking speeds closer to HBM. The proposal is not a replacement for deployed HBM today, but it highlights how memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming a first-order limiter for larger AI models.
summary.zh: 一种受存储技术启发的高带宽闪存方案被定位为可将GPU容量提升至多TB级，并争取接近HBM的速度。它并非当下已部署HBM的替代品，但凸显出内存容量和带宽正在成为更大AI模型的一阶限制因素。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Genesis Mission awardee pursues X-ray lithography challenge to ASML
title.zh: 获Genesis Mission资助团队尝试以X射线光刻挑战ASML

summary.en: An awardee in the U.S. Genesis Mission program is pursuing X-ray lithography as a potential challenge to ASML's established lithography position. The effort is an early technology bet: proving source power, mask infrastructure, throughput, and process economics remains far harder than demonstrating a novel exposure concept.
summary.zh: 美国Genesis Mission项目的一家获资助团队正探索X射线光刻，以挑战ASML已建立的光刻地位。这仍是一项早期技术押注：要证明光源功率、掩模生态、吞吐量和工艺经济性，远比展示一种新曝光概念更困难。

title.en: Report identifies Aishengna in China's immersion-DUV effort
title.zh: 报道称爱生纳参与中国浸没式DUV光刻设备研发

summary.en: Tom's Hardware reports that Shanghai Aishengna has been identified by an unnamed source as the developer of a domestic immersion-DUV scanner effort, while the named companies did not comment. The report places a viable domestic 7 nm-capable scanner as far out as 2038, illustrating both the strategic importance and long development horizon of lithography localization.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware报道称，一名匿名消息人士认定上海爱生纳正在开发国产浸没式DUV扫描仪，而相关公司未予置评。报道将具备7 nm能力的国产可用扫描仪时间点放在2038年，说明光刻本土化既具战略重要性，也有漫长的研发周期。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: United States signs $874 million in semiconductor-research letters of intent
title.zh: 美国签署总额8.74亿美元的半导体研究意向书

summary.en: The United States signed letters of intent worth $874 million to support semiconductor research. The commitments put public money behind the research layer of the supply chain, where advances in materials, processes, design tools, and packaging can shape manufacturing competitiveness years before a new fab reaches volume.
summary.zh: 美国签署了总额8.74亿美元的半导体研究意向书。这些承诺将公共资金投向供应链的研发层；材料、工艺、设计工具和封装的进步，往往会在新晶圆厂量产前多年塑造制造竞争力。

title.en: Apple keeps evaluating Chinese memory suppliers amid Senate pushback
title.zh: 面对参议员施压，苹果仍在评估中国存储供应商

summary.en: Apple said it is evaluating multiple memory sources, including Chinese vendors, as it seeks relief from supply constraints and higher memory costs. The choice has become a policy issue as U.S. lawmakers oppose potential sourcing from CXMT and YMTC, turning a component-procurement decision into a test of supply-chain strategy.
summary.zh: 苹果表示，正评估包括中国厂商在内的多种存储来源，以缓解供应约束和更高的存储成本。由于美国议员反对可能从CXMT和YMTC采购，这一元件采购选择已成为供应链战略的政策考验。

theme.en: Inference Research Moves Across Memory and Hardware
theme.zh: 推理研究跨越存储与硬件层次

dek.en: This week's papers move inference optimization from low-bit arithmetic into memory placement, photonics, and three-dimensional cache. The common thread is treating data movement, implementation cost, and runtime scheduling as parts of the same design problem.
dek.zh: 本周论文将推理优化从低比特运算延伸到存储放置、光子计算和三维缓存。共同主线是把数据移动、实现成本与运行时调度视为同一个设计问题。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Connecting RowHammer and RowPress experiments to device models
title.zh: 连接RowHammer与RowPress实验及器件模型

papers.authors: Haocong Luo, Longda Zhou, et al.

summary.en: This work examines where device-level explanations of RowHammer and RowPress disagree with observed DRAM bit-flip behavior. By focusing on flip direction, flip count, and aggressor-row requirements, it aims to give future characterization and mitigation work a more consistent physical basis rather than relying only on empirical rules.
summary.zh: 该工作检视了RowHammer和RowPress的器件级解释与实际DRAM位翻转行为之间的差异。论文聚焦翻转方向、翻转数量和攻击行需求，力图为后续表征与缓解提供更一致的物理基础，而不只依赖经验规则。

title.en: Layout-aware AQFP buffer and splitter insertion
title.zh: 面向版图的AQFP缓冲器与分路器插入

papers.authors: Robert S. Aviles, Ziyu Liu, et al.

summary.en: The paper recasts AQFP buffer and splitter insertion as minimizing the width-depth product, a metric intended to track physical-design area better than cell count or logic depth alone. It proves the formulation NP-complete and proposes scalable heuristics, addressing a practical layout bottleneck in superconducting AQFP circuits with explicit fanout and pipeline constraints.
summary.zh: 论文将AQFP缓冲器与分路器插入重构为最小化宽度与深度乘积，该指标旨在比单纯的单元数或逻辑深度更好地反映物理设计面积。作者证明该问题为NP完全，并提出可扩展启发式方法，以解决具有显式扇出和流水约束的超导AQFP电路的版图瓶颈。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: LightRot: low-bit LLM inference with lightweight rotations
title.zh: LightRot：以轻量旋转实现低比特LLM推理

papers.authors: Sangjin Kim, Yuseon Choi, et al.

summary.en: LightRot combines grouped local rotation and outlier-direction alignment with a hierarchical fast-Hadamard-transform rotation unit for low-bit LLM inference. In a 28 nm CMOS implementation, the authors report 27.4 TOPS/W peak efficiency for 4-bit inference, while the result still depends on the modeled accelerator and the selected LLaMA evaluation workloads.
summary.zh: LightRot将分组局部旋转与离群方向对齐结合，并采用分层快速Hadamard变换旋转单元支持低比特LLM推理。作者在28 nm CMOS实现中报告4比特推理峰值能效为27.4 TOPS/W，但结果仍取决于建模的加速器及所选LLaMA评测负载。

title.en: NELSSA places mixed-length LLM requests across GPUs and PNM
title.zh: NELSSA在GPU与PNM间放置混合长度LLM请求

papers.authors: Sookyung Choi, Seungyong Lee, et al.

summary.en: NELSSA routes short-context LLM requests to GPUs and long-context requests to processing-near-memory devices, with migration when a context grows. Its prototype combines PNM sparse attention, GPU decode kernels, and a CXL-enabled runtime, making it a systems proposal for the mixed request lengths that reduce GPU-only batch efficiency.
summary.zh: NELSSA将短上下文LLM请求路由至GPU，将长上下文请求路由至近存处理PNM设备，并在上下文增长时进行迁移。其原型结合PNM稀疏注意力、GPU解码内核和支持CXL的运行时，旨在处理会削弱纯GPU批处理效率的混合请求长度。

title.en: LLMET evaluates monolithic-3D memory for LLM serving
title.zh: LLMET评估面向LLM服务的单片三维存储

papers.authors: Ming-Yen Lee, Hanchen Yang, et al.

summary.en: LLMET is a cross-layer simulation framework for examining how monolithic-3D cache memories change LLM-serving energy. The study reports that expanding L2 from 40 MB to 1 GB reduces chip energy by 44% for Llama 3.1 70B prefill with a 16K context, a promising modeled result that requires realizable M3D memory integration.
summary.zh: LLMET是一套跨层仿真框架，用于考察单片三维缓存如何改变LLM服务的能耗。研究报告称，在16K上下文的Llama 3.1 70B预填充阶段，将L2从40 MB扩展至1 GB可使芯片能耗降低44%；这是有前景的建模结果，但仍依赖可实现的M3D存储集成。

title.en: MDTransformer uses mode-division photonics for transformer acceleration
title.zh: MDTransformer以模式复用光子计算加速Transformer

papers.authors: Solomon Micheal Serunjogi, Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra, et al.

summary.en: MDTransformer proposes a photonic transformer co-design that uses spatial modes as independent compute lanes, avoiding multi-wavelength generation and spectral filtering. Its inverse-designed coherent crossbar and IQ modulation target complex matrix operations in the optical domain, but practical value will depend on end-to-end optical packaging, calibration, and electronic I/O overheads.
summary.zh: MDTransformer提出一种光子Transformer协同设计，将空间模式作为独立计算通道，从而避免多波长光源和频谱滤波。其逆向设计的相干交叉阵列与IQ调制瞄准光域复数矩阵运算，但实际价值仍取决于端到端光封装、校准以及电子I/O开销。

title.en: PIMID broadens full-system simulation for processing-in-memory
title.zh: PIMID扩展面向存内计算的全系统仿真

papers.authors: Yuan He, Masaaki Kondo, et al.

summary.en: PIMID presents an execution- and trace-driven full-system simulator for processing-in-memory designs. It spans shared-memory and message-passing execution, eleven memory technologies, and placements from subarrays to logic dies, addressing the blind spots of device-only PIM models while still depending on the quality of its component assumptions.
summary.zh: PIMID提出一套面向存内计算设计、由执行与轨迹驱动的全系统仿真器。它覆盖共享内存和消息传递执行模型、11种存储技术，以及从子阵列到逻辑裸片的处理单元放置，弥补仅器件级PIM模型的盲点，但仍依赖各组件假设的准确性。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: ARES steers LLM reasoning effort for RTL PPA optimization
title.zh: ARES为RTL PPA优化调度LLM推理强度

papers.authors: Stef Cuyckens, Mihaela Jivanescu, et al.

summary.en: ARES adapts an LLM agent's reasoning effort during RTL optimization, escalating only after lower-effort iterations stall, and reports normalized dollar cost alongside PPA outcomes. On three unseen test designs, the authors report a 23–27% figure-of-merit reduction versus 16–23% for the best fixed effort, although the training and evaluation set is small.
summary.zh: ARES在RTL优化过程中自适应调整LLM代理的推理强度，仅在低强度迭代停滞后升级，并将标准化美元成本与PPA结果一同报告。作者在三个未见测试设计上报告，FoM降低23–27%，而最佳固定强度为16–23%；但训练和评测集规模较小。

title.en: SPARC traces pre-silicon power side-channel leakage to its source
title.zh: SPARC追溯流片前功耗侧信道泄漏根因

papers.authors: Andrija Nešković, Christian Ewert, et al.

summary.en: SPARC automates pre-silicon detection and root-cause analysis of processor power side-channel leakage using macro-cell information-flow tracking and enhanced shadow logic. It attributes secret-dependent switching to hardware signals and corresponding software instructions, which could make mitigation more actionable than a leakage score alone; validation is reported on open-source RISC-V CPUs.
summary.zh: SPARC利用宏单元级信息流跟踪和增强影子逻辑，自动检测并根因分析处理器流片前功耗侧信道泄漏。它将秘密相关开关活动归因到硬件信号及相应软件指令，因此比单独给出泄漏分数更有助于缓解；验证对象为开源RISC-V CPU。
